title: Choo-choo train, the same words, a wider scene (a negative result)
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (the same Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free, the same message as v5 word for word; the runtime now checks the wheels against the direction of travel
verdict: A negative result, kept. The agent covered the whole 256 x 256 plot with grass, so the locomotive is a small piece in the middle of a field, and it added a second track, lamp posts, a water crane and a thicker plume. It has no wheels you can see. The runtime counts 381 floating parts (489 blocks): mostly small white wool pieces, probably steam, and some glass that is not steam. The scene reads as a small town with a plume of smoke, not a train. Two debug scripts were left uncommitted in the folder.
